# Luma AI

> Create AI videos from text or images, generate photos, and edit with multiple models and ready-made templates. See the exact credit cost before you create.

Luma AI is a web application operated by Luma AI LTD. It is not affiliated with Luma Labs or Dream Machine.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://luma.ai/)
- [AI Video Generator](https://luma.ai/ai-video-generator)
- [Image to Video](https://luma.ai/image-to-video)
- [Text to Video](https://luma.ai/text-to-video)
- [AI Image Generator](https://luma.ai/ai-image-generator)
- [AI Lip Sync](https://luma.ai/ai-lip-sync)
- [AI Photo Editor](https://luma.ai/ai-photo-editor)
- [AI Video Editor](https://luma.ai/ai-video-editor)
- [First and Last Frame Video](https://luma.ai/first-last-frame-video)
- [Motion Transfer](https://luma.ai/motion-transfer)
- [Reframe Video](https://luma.ai/reframe-video)
- [Video Enhancer](https://luma.ai/video-enhancer)
- [Video Extender](https://luma.ai/video-extender)
- [Luma AI MCP for AI assistants](https://luma.ai/mcp)
- [Pricing and plans](https://luma.ai/pricing)
- [Current pricing, machine readable](https://luma.ai/pricing.md)
- [Privacy policy](https://luma.ai/privacy-policy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://luma.ai/terms-and-conditions)
- [Content policy](https://luma.ai/content-policy)

## Product areas

- AI photo generation
- Text-to-video and image-to-video generation
- Photo and video editing tools
- Ready-made video templates

## MCP server

Luma AI runs a remote MCP server that lets supported AI assistants, including Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, make images and videos with a Luma AI account: https://luma.ai/api/mcp

- Sign-in: OAuth with a Luma AI account. The client opens the Luma sign-in and the user approves access once.
- Cost: every generation is paid with the user's own Luma credits, at the same prices as on luma.ai. The connected AI assistant makes what the user asks for right away and mentions credits only when the balance runs short or the user asks; the estimate_cost tool answers what a generation would cost, and the balance is on the user's Luma account page.
- Setup for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients: https://luma.ai/mcp

### Creator workflows

- [Make anything with Luma](https://luma.ai/mcp/generate): Say what you want: the workflow picks the tool and settings and makes it.
- [Make a short film](https://luma.ai/mcp/short-film): From a one-line idea to a titled short film: script, shots, motion and sound.
- [Bring a photo to life](https://luma.ai/mcp/photo-to-video): One photo in, a few moving versions out: effects and a natural animation.
- [Restyle a photo or video](https://luma.ai/mcp/restyle): Redraw a photo, or one of your Luma videos, in a new style, side by side.
- [Turn photos into a memory reel](https://luma.ai/mcp/memory-reel): Five to ten photos become a short recap with transitions, ready for your own music.
- [Make a vertical hook clip](https://luma.ai/mcp/vertical-hook): A vertical clip built to grab attention in the first second, with an optional loop.
- [Keep a character consistent](https://luma.ai/mcp/character-sheet): Keep one character looking the same across angles, outfits and scenes.
- [Make a product clip](https://luma.ai/mcp/product-clip): Clean up a product photo, then make short vertical and square motion clips.
- [Make a talking ad](https://luma.ai/mcp/talking-ad): Your face, your voice and your product become a captioned vertical ad with product shots and music.
- [Fit a video to every feed](https://luma.ai/mcp/every-feed): One video in, a copy for every feed out: the subject whole in each shape, sharpened, and checked.

Prices and available models can change. Use the current pricing page and the controls shown inside the product as the source of truth.
